in_marathi.name: Bhrat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhratā', meaning brother. In Hindu mythology, Bhratas are the protectors, the guardians, and the keepers of the Dharma. They are known for their courage and their unwavering commitment to their family and their community.
